translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: 1 TIMOTEO
book.title: An c’a’al u axi thuchanchat a Timoteo c’al an t’ocat abathuale Pablo

content: In uchbil axi belom c’al a Cristo
Yab ca c’uiya’ an yejtselabchic. Ca tauna’ c’al i c’ac’naxtalab ejtil max pel a tata. Ca t’ajchi an cuitolchic ejtil max pel a cuete’ ebchal ta q’uima’.
Ca t’ajchi an uxcue’labchic ejtil max pel a mim ani an ts’ic’achchic ejtil max pel a uxum ebchal. Yab ca quithab tauna’ i ts’ic’ach.
Ca tolmiy i tsemchith uxum axi lej cuetem ani ts’ejhuantal.

Max in cua’al in cuete’ tsacamil ani max in cua’al in momob, jats c’al ta ca tolmiyat. Pel in lej uchbil jaja’chic tin tamet a Dios quin tolmiy in at ja’ub xits’al. Antsana’ ca huichbanchat an alhua’talab axi pel i tatalab ani axi pel i mimlab. Ne’ets ca culbe a Dios c’al jitats antsana’ quin tolminchi i tsemchith uxum.
Axi lej chubax cuetem an tsemchith uxum ani pel i belom im palenchal a Dios. Yab im palc’anchal ni hue’ ti ol q’uicha ani acal.
An tsemchith uxum axi expith in q’uijithnal quin t’aja’ in cuete’ culbetal, nix ejtil max tsemenec in ejattal.
Timoteo, ca huat’banchi axe’ xi uchbixtalab c’al patal an ebchalab. Quim putuchic jaye c’al in uchbil quin tolmiy an tsemchith uxum.

Pel in uchbil quin tolmiy in at ja’ub xits’al ani in lej cua’al in uchbil quin luba’ quin tolmiy axi tin cuete’ q’uima’. Max yab in tolmiyal, yab im putuhual c’al in uchbil ti belom c’al a Cristo. Ma yab im bajuhual ti tolmix ejtil ti tolmix axi yab u belom.
Ti al an tamcunel ebchalab ca thuchan im bij ti al an bijlab tsemchith uxum expith i tsemchith uxum ax in cua’alits huat’ath ox inic i tamub ani max in co’oyamal juncats in tomquil.

Max exlamejits ti alhua’ uxum, max alhua’ in yejthamalits in tsacamilchic, max in coythamalits i tsa’bix tin q’uima’, max in tolmiyamalits an ebchalabchic c’al jahuaquits hue’ i tolmixtalab, max in tolmiyamalits ax in yajchicnal, max lej canat quin t’ajchi i alhua’talab, ja’its axe’ ca thuchan im bij ti al an bijlab tsemchith uxum.
Yab ca thuchan im bij i tsemchith uxum axi yabaye in cua’al ox inic i tamub. Hualam max yabats ca ts’at’ey c’al a Cristo ani quin le’naye ca tomquin junil.
Pel i hualabtalab max yabats ca ts’at’ey c’al a Cristo, cum in cuxnal an cau jahua’ in uluhuits ocoxe abal ne’ets ca junini’ ts’at’ey c’al a Cristo.

Hualam max quin ujna’ ti obe, ani ti belelma’ ti q’uimath ti q’uimath, ani ti t’uchichil c’al i cau, ani ti otscaclome, ani ti balq’uic’ma’ c’al i cau axi yab in cuenta, ani t’ilomnax c’al jahua’ yab in tomnal.

Jaxtam abal yab antsana’ quin ujna’, ca tomquin junil an tsemchith uxum axi yabaye uxcue’its. Quin co’oy i tsacam ani quin alhua’ beletna’chic. Antsana’ ti quin t’aja’ abal yab ca elchin jant’o ta ca jolbiyat c’al axi tomolnax c’al a Cristo.
Hua’ats i ebchalabchic tsemchith uxum axi pilmejits c’al a Cristo, ani xo’ ts’at’at c’al a Satanás.

Quin t’aja’ ti cuenta ax u belom c’al a Cristo, max pel i inic ani max pel i uxum, in uchbil quin tolmiy an tsemchith uxum axi pel in at ja’ub xits’al. Yab quin huat’banchi ca tolminchat c’al an tamcunel ebchalab. Tam an tamcunel ebchalabchic ne’ets quin co’oy jant’o quin tolmiy i tsemchith uxum axi lej chubax cuetem ani ts’ejhuantal.

An eyalchic c’al an tamcunel ebchalabchic ca c’ac’na lej max im putuhual c’al in uchbil ani alhua’ ti eyal. Aniye ca lej más c’athpich c’ac’na ax in t’ajal alhua’ ti thajchix ani ti exobchix c’al in cahuintal a Dios.
In ulal in T’ocat Thuchlabil a Dios abal yab ca melchin in hui’ an hueyax tam tu eyenthab ti c’uchil c’al in huitslablil an lab em. Jaye in ulal abal in tomnal ca jalbinchat an t’ojnal.

Max ca jolbiyat axi eyal ti al an tamcunel ebchalab c’al juncats i jolbix, yab ca t’ajchin ti cuenta an jolbixtalab. Max c’al tsab ani max ox i jolbix quin tejhua’methanchi abal chubax hualbinenec an eyal, tam ojni’ ca ts’ejcan an cau.
Max chubax hualbinenec, tam ojni’ ca c’uiyan tin tamet an tamcunel ebchalab abal ca jic’tson xi q’ue’atchic ani yab ca hualbin jaye.

Jats nan tu lej uchbiyal Timoteo c’al axe’ xi cau tin cuenta max ca hualbin axi eyal ti al an tamcunel ebchalab. Ca bolith ts’ejca’ patal jahuaquits tam eyal axi jolbinenec, yab ca poc’oth ts’ejca’chic jun c’al xi jun. Ti t’ajchal ti cuenta max chubax a putuhual c’al a uchbil a Dios ani an Ajatic Jesucristo ani an ángelchic axi c’uajat c’al a Dios.

Ca lej t’aja’ ti cuenta yab ca jun athic bijiy jitaquitsq’ui tam ebchalab ti eyal c’al an tamcunel ebchalab. Max ca thubat bijiy jita’ ax u hualbinal, ejtil max in hualab jaye pel a hualab. Ca bijiy expith axi t’ocat, ani tata’ Timoteo jaye ets’ey ca t’aja’ jahua’ t’ocat.
Cum huichate an yau’lats ta chucul, ca uts’a’ hue’ i vino ani yab expith i ja’.
Hua’ats i inicchic ax u tejhua’ hualbinal ani hua’ats ax u tsinat hualbinal. Ax u tsinat hualbinal ne’ets ca tso’obna in hualab talbel tam ca ts’ejca c’al a Dios.
Aniye jaye hua’ats i inicchic ax in tejhua’ t’ajal alhua’ ani hua’ats ax in tsinat t’ajal alhua’. Ax in tsinat t’ajal alhua’ ne’ets ca tso’obna in alhua’ t’ajbil talbel.
